text: City Transportation Staff reviewed the position of the “No Stopping” sign on the south side of Annette Street, between a point 49 metres west of Evelyn Avenue and point 43 metres east of High Park Avenue and have provided the below recommendations to slightly change the location of the sign.

City Council on May 22 and 23, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend the existing stopping prohibition in effect at all times, on the south side of Annette Street, between a point 49 metres west of Evelyn Avenue and a point 43 metres east of High Park Avenue, to be in effect between a point 56 metres west of Evelyn Avenue and a point 43 metres east of High Park Avenue.
